scope.coverageNote: 10/10 means no identified defect remains in the declared audited scope after the documented checks. criteria.result: 128/128 source SHA-256 fingerprints independently matched the stored Java files. Dataset fingerprints and APK identity are recorded.
No relevant framing/transport changes or regression identified. The source-based checks and independently recomputed CRC fixture from round 1 remain applicable.
The three float inputs now use the real-number category. Generic Number and unions have separate classifications. Profile parser keys and fallbacks are present and distinct from model names.

criteria.criterion: Wire data versus internal application models
criteria.result: WorkState, StateInfo, file-list models and related fields are separated into localModelParameterIds/localModelPaths. 62007 and 70400 wire paths match the inspected reads. All 90 receive entries were checked for the former model-field promotion pattern.

criteria.criterion: Function input, result, event and error contracts
criteria.result: startGlassOTA now distinguishes the immediate empty-map acknowledgement from eight asynchronous callbacks, with event fields, observed statuses and conditional message omission. Generic Result observations are recorded conservatively, with incomplete/delegated contracts explicitly limited.
The existing marshalling, route, authentication and model-identity distinctions remain intact; no unsupported LLM identity, secret or universal server constraint was introduced.
The firmware analysis continues to distinguish OTA route clues, the Android transfer path, candidate assets and an actual firmware image; no device extraction or decompilation is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Consistency across earlier and newer documents
criteria.result: All four historical research reports inspected have prominent stage notes and current-result paths. Architecture/protocol labels describe channel inventories as heuristic candidates rather than complete invocable contracts.

Bidirectional input/output/local-model references passed. Independent browser checks confirmed local-model sections, OTA acknowledgement/event presentation, real-number filtering and mobile width without JS errors.

The documentation explicitly distinguishes parsed evidence from incomplete/delegated structures and hardware validation. The audit preserves its exclusions and does not extend the score to unreviewed corpus content.
